exceptions.title: General Waste Bin Service Review and Community Consultation
exceptions.officer_recommendation: it is recommended that as per the Notice of Motion, the Town undertake community consultation to obtain an understanding of current waste needs and service gaps. The outcomes of this consultation can then be reported back to Council for consideration. Based on the findings, Council may consider the options available such as a new Waste Assistance Policy and/or supporting guidelines to address any identified needs. This staged approach ensures that any future approach is evidence-based, responsive to community feedback, equitable, and aligned with the Town's broader waste management and sustainability objectives.
exceptions.motion_text: That Council REQUESTS the Chief Executive Officer to: 1. Undertake a review of the Town's waste service levels, including red-lid general waste bin collection frequencies and options for opt-in weekly collection in defined circumstances; 2. Consider associated fees and charges implications; 3. Undertake community consultation on waste service preferences; and 4. Report back to Council.
exceptions.quote: There have been a number of changes in the waste management landscape over the past few years. The Town's Waste Management Strategy came to an end in 2025.
